question: In which of the following states is the famous Rumtek monastery located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sikkim**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Rumtek Monastery **is one of the oldest monastery located in Sikkim, founded by Wangchuk Dorjee in 1966**.
 
• It is **also related to Karmapa controversy.**
 
• Rumtek Monastery is set atop a hill overlooking Gangtok and is one of Sikkim's most important and substantial monasteries.
 
• In the sixteenth century, Wangchuk Dorje, the ninth Karmapa Lama, constructed the monastery.
 
• It was formerly known as the Dharma Chakra Center and is home to a stunning shrine temple and a monastic community.
 
• The shrine was built with the intention of spreading the Buddha's teachings throughout the world.
 
• The Rumtek Monastery is 23 kilometres from Gangtok and is encircled by mountains that are lush and verdant.
 
• The monastery features a golden stupa and numerous sculptures that belonged to the 16th Karmapa preserved.
 
• After China seized Tibet, many religious gurus moved from Tibet to Sikkim, giving the monastery its prominence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Famous Monasteries located in Jammu Kashmir is Alchi Monastery, Basgo Monastery, Chemrey Gompa, Dikshit Monastery.
 
• Famous Temples located in Himachal Pradesh is Sankat Mochan Temple, Tara Devi Temple Jakhoo Temple, Hidimba Temple, Maa Sharvari Temple, Vashisht Temple, Naina Devi Ji.
 
• Famous Monasteries located in Arunachal Pradesh is Tawang Monastery, Bomdila Monastery, Urgelling Monastery.
